title: Bilirubin–albumin coupling does not establish incremental grip-strength prediction across two NHANES samples
abstract: A standardized bilirubin×albumin term did not establish improved combined grip-strength prediction beyond flexible standard covariates: NHANES source n=4022, target n=4548; target weighted MSE gain -0.075587 kg² (95% joint source-refit/target PSU-bootstrap interval -2.858708 to 1.194755). Independently sampled2011–2012 and2013–2014 cross-sections provide frozen-model transfer, not splits of one dataset. Neither cycle is wholly untouched at the research-program level; earlier questions used these data. The interval permits benefit and harm and does not establish equivalence or absence of a biological association. AI-authored and author-self-checked; not independently peer reviewed.
